cards.card_text: Tola's descendants are counted in their genealogies as 22,600 mighty men of valor.
cards.verse_text: In the days of David, 22,600 descendants of Tola were numbered in their genealogies as mighty men of valor.
cards.snippet: …the days of David, 22,600 descendants of Tola were numbered in their genealogies as mighty men of valor.

cards.card_text: All these Benjamite heads of families, the chiefs in their genealogies, live in ___.
cards.verse_text: All these were heads of families, the chiefs according to their genealogies, and they lived in Jerusalem.
cards.snippet: All these were heads of families, the chiefs according to their genealogies, and they lived in Jerusalem.

cards.card_text: For chapters now, the writer of Chronicles has been listing family after family (1 Chronicles 1-8), and here he wraps it up: all Israel was recorded in the genealogies written in the Book of the Kings of Israel.
cards.verse_text: So all Israel was recorded in the genealogies written in the Book of the Kings of Israel.
cards.snippet: So all Israel was recorded in the genealogies written in the Book of the Kings of Israel.

cards.card_text: All told, 212 men are chosen to be gatekeepers at the thresholds, registered by genealogy in their villages.
cards.verse_text: They were registered by genealogy in their villages.
cards.snippet: They were registered by genealogy in their villages.

cards.verse_text: Then my God put it into my heart to assemble the nobles, the officials, and the people to be enrolled by genealogy.
cards.snippet: …assemble the nobles, the officials, and the people to be enrolled by genealogy.

cards.card_text: Right when Nehemiah wants the people enrolled by genealogy, what does he find?
cards.verse_text: Then my God put it into my heart to assemble the nobles, the officials, and the people to be enrolled by genealogy.
cards.snippet: …assemble the nobles, the officials, and the people to be enrolled by genealogy.

cards.card_text: Friend, the Gospel of Matthew opens with the record of the genealogy of Jesus Christ, the son of David, the son of Abraham.
cards.verse_text: This is the record of the genealogy of Jesus Christ, the son of David, the son of Abraham:
cards.snippet: This is the record of the genealogy of Jesus Christ, the son of David, the son of Abraham:

cards.card_text: Certain men in Ephesus are devoting themselves to myths and endless genealogies.
cards.verse_text: As I urged you on my departure to Macedonia, you should stay on at Ephesus to instruct certain men not to teach false doctrines or devote themselves to myths and endless genealogies, which promote speculation rather than the stewardship of God’s work, which is by faith.

cards.card_text: Paul says those myths and endless genealogies promote ___ rather than the stewardship of God's work.
cards.verse_text: or devote themselves to myths and endless genealogies, which promote speculation rather than the stewardship of God’s work, which is by faith.

cards.card_text: Then he gives Titus a list of things to avoid: foolish controversies, genealogies, arguments and quarrels about the law.
cards.verse_text: But avoid foolish controversies, genealogies, arguments, and quarrels about the law, because these things are pointless and worthless.

cards.card_text: Then the writer describes Melchizedek: without father or mother or genealogy, without beginning of days or end of life.
cards.verse_text: Without father or mother or genealogy, without beginning of days or end of life, like the Son of God, he remains a priest for all time.
